acceptance_criteria: **Open** the cloned platform (via docker-compose up) and see a polished landing/onboarding page.
**Type** a natural-language description of an application (e.g. "Build a SaaS task manager with user auth, Stripe billing, and a dashboard").
**Watch** a multi-agent team — powered **exclusively by NVIDIA NIM** — plan, code, test, and produce a working full-stack app, with streaming progress visible in the UI.
**See a live preview** of that app rendering and functioning.
**Iterate via chat** ("add dark mode", "fix the login bug") and watch the preview update.
**Export the code** or obtain a deployable artifact (download / GitHub sync).
**Verify** the entire inference path uses only NVIDIA NIM (no other provider calls in logs/code).
**Persistence:** projects, conversations, and artifacts survive restarts; credits are tracked.
**Verification report:** a recorded flow / screenshots of a real non-trivial app built from a single prompt using only NIM.
PLAN.md contains real Requirements, Risks, and Acceptance Criteria sections (this document).
NIM connectivity + working client confirmed (already green: `pytest tests/test_nim_client.py -v`).
